verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair axis for a remote-desktop product, but the evidence shows only a structured, parameter-based CLI and a REST API for scripting and integrations, plus an llms.txt docs index. These are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not a documented natural-language command interface. No evidence shows AnyDesk accepting or interpreting natural-language instructions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
